items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did a memorable weekend barbecue-family picnic kind of thing with Lee Morgan and Paul Chambers out in Queens

ctx.x: You were sick of bad pianos, right?

I was sick of bad pianos. I was embarrassed more than sick of it. I wanted to play the piano, but I kept being embarrassed about how I sounded because they were all so bad. So I thought, “well, I love the drums; let me do that.” I gigged around on drums at a few places. I did a memorable weekend barbecue-family picnic kind of thing with Lee Morgan and Paul Chambers out in Queens, I’ll never forget... I did anything that came along.
